Giver: Right. First, leave Start. Head left.
Follower: Okay. Left.
Giver: Keep going left until you hit the white water.
Follower: Left... okay, I see the white water. I'm past it now.
Giver: Wait, no. Left *from* the white water. Go up a bit, then turn right.
Follower: Ah, past the white water. Okay, going right.
Giver: Turn right. Follow that little creek to the stone slabs.
Follower: Stone slabs... there they are.
Giver: Go down the stone slabs. Then turn left.
Follower: Left from the slabs.
Giver: Keep going left until you reach the swamp.
Follower: Swamp is over there. Okay, heading for the swamp.
Giver: Don't go *in* the swamp. Stop right at the edge. Then turn right.
Follower: Right.
Giver: Go straight until you pass the cactus.
Follower: I don't see a cactus. Is there one?
Giver: No, ignore that. Just keep going straight until you pass the outlaws hideout.
Follower: Okay, passing the outlaws hideout.
Giver: Good. Now turn left. Head towards the stone creek.
Follower: Left. Where's the stone creek?
Giver: It's the one to the left of the rocks.
Follower: Ah! There's a stone creek to the left of the rocks. Okay, heading for that one.
Giver: Yes, that's the right one. Go all the way down it.
Follower: Following it down... okay, I'm at the bottom.
Giver: Stop at the bottom. Turn right. Go across to the gold mine.
Follower: Right. Gold mine is right there.
Giver: Good. Now go down from the gold mine.
Follower: Going down... okay, I'm past the gold mine.
Giver: Turn left at the noose.
Follower: Left at the noose.
Giver: Follow that line down to the saloon bar.
Follower: Okay, going down to the saloon bar.
Giver: Stop at the saloon bar. Turn right. Go to the swan pond.
Follower: Right. Swan pond is right there.
Giver: Good. Now head left from the swan pond.
Follower: Left from the swan pond.
Giver: Keep going left until you reach the stone creek again.
Follower: Stone creek... wait, there's only one stone creek on my map.
Giver: No, there are two. One near the top, one near the bottom. The one near the bottom.
Follower: Ah! The bottom one. Okay, heading for the bottom stone creek.
Giver: Good. Go down that creek until you hit the FINISH.
Follower: Going down... okay, I'm at the finish.
Giver: Perfect.
Follower: Done.
